d: Deep plum, shoulder-length hair with straight bangs and a small side-ponytail is paired with golden-yellow, narrow eyes and a confident expression. The face appears as a late teenager with a slender, lithe build. The outfit consists of a pink military-style blazer and matching miniskirt with gold buttons and a white belt, worn under a short black-and-grey checkered capelet with a lime-green lining, complemented by a yellow bow tie, white gloves, dark grey tights, and white ankle boots. Signature details include a small pink pillbox hat with a lime-green accent and a large open magical book with glowing blue circular patterns.
